parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift`. The two methods — `recordRequestSentIncrementsCount` (line 38) and `recordSongAddedToLibraryIncrementsCount` (line 54) — test structurally similar but semantically distinct behaviours (recording a review-request event vs. recording a song-added-to-library event), so their shape similarity (Jaccard 0.75) is expected and intentional. Collapsing them into a shared helper would obscure the distinct domain actions under test and reduce test-failure clarity.
